---
title: "Stats — 30-day coverage overview"
description: "Average coverage and best/worst day in the last 30 days."
output: /data/stats_coverage.json
format: object
---

Cobertura média + melhor/pior dia nos últimos 30 dias. Cada "cobertura" =
número de tribunais distintos com `ia_status='uploaded'` naquela data.

`best_day`/`worst_day` só consideram dias **settled** (mesmo critério de
`absent_confirmed`/`pending_real` de `site_status.qmd`): um dia com par(es)
`pending_real` (DJEN confirmou o caderno mas o upload ainda não aconteceu,
dentro do SLO de 24h de `docs/SERVICE_OBJECTIVES.md`) não é um dia de
cobertura ruim, é um dia que ainda não terminou de processar -- exatamente
por isso `collect-zips.yml`/`src/djen_backup/__main__.py` já excluem "hoje"
do próprio range de checagem por padrão. `avg_coverage` continua somando
todos os dias da janela (o card "Cobertura média" descreve os últimos 30
dias como um todo, não apenas os já settled).

```{sql}
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    tribunal,
    coalesce(CAST(ia_status AS VARCHAR), '') = 'uploaded' AS uploaded,
    coalesce(CAST(djen_raw AS VARCHAR), '') IN ('404', '400', 'no_publications') AS raw_absent
  FROM manifest
  WHERE date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uploaded) AS collected,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT uploaded AND NOT raw_absent) AS unsettled
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(collected), 2)::DOUBLE AS avg_coverage,
  MAX(collected) FILTER (WHERE unsettled = 0) AS best_count,
  CAST(ARG_MAX(date, collected) FILTER (WHERE unsettled = 0) AS VARCHAR) AS best_day,
  MIN(collected) FILTER (WHERE unsettled = 0) AS worst_count,
  CAST(ARG_MIN(date, collected) FILTER (WHERE unsettled = 0) AS VARCHAR) AS worst_day
FROM daily;
```
